**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (no redline proposed).**

The Agreement contains no auto-renewal machinery. The only renewal-adjacent language is § 10's "renewable one-year term" for Maintenance Services, contingent on our continued payment of maintenance fees — an optional, non-evergreen renewal. There is accordingly no non-renewal notice window binding us and no Vendor price-uplift right, so every conditional fallback and preferred element is satisfied vacuously, and neither walk-away trigger (>90-day window, automatic multi-year renewal) is present. The term structure is affirmatively favourable to us: perpetual while fees are paid (§ 17(a)) with a Sparkling exit on 90 days' notice (§ 17(b)).

Noted in the rationale only, not redlined: § 10 does not expressly say renewal is by mutual written agreement, and renewal pricing lives in Schedule "A" (Fee Schedule), which is not in the reviewed text — worth confirming that schedule carries no uplift formula.
